user.title: Geely Connect
user.description: Unofficial community integration — not affiliated with Geely. Enter your Geely account email and pick your country, and we'll send a 6-digit code to your inbox.

code.title: Enter the code from your inbox
code.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Paste it here.

pick_vehicle.title: Pick a vehicle
pick_vehicle.description: Your Geely account has multiple vehicles. Pick the one to add. Already-configured vehicles are not shown.

error.send_code_failed: Failed to send the email code. Try again in a minute.
error.captcha_failed: Captcha solver hit an error - please retry.
error.invalid_code: That code wasn't accepted. It may have expired (codes are single-use).
error.no_vehicles: Login succeeded but no vehicles were found on this account.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This Geely vehicle is already set up.
abort.all_configured: All vehicles on this account are already configured.
abort.cert_failed: Failed to provision the per-device mTLS certificate. Check the logs.
abort.wrong_region: This Geely account is not served by the EU/International cloud. Geely runs separate backends for APAC, North America and South America, each needing its own app credentials, so this integration currently supports EU/International accounts only.
abort.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the logs.

init.title: Options
init.description: Change how often Home Assistant polls the car, the tire-pressure unit and the entity language. Faster polling logs the phone app out more often.

data.full_exposure: Expose every raw field (adds ~180 diagnostic entities)
